verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework that persists memory and workflow state, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. However, the evidence only shows that agents can store message history and that projects can be self-hosted. Nothing documents retention policies, TTLs, or APIs for deleting threads, messages or snapshots. Self-hosting and optional history storage are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
